notes.title: Oh Baby Kart: Patch v1.15
notes.notes:
DEFENDER MODE 
 Defender mode is here!  Try to get the highest score possible with a group of fellow racers. Protect the base from chickens with knives, bulls and even turtles with canons. 
 Team up to compete on the Group Leaderboard  To kick start this mode  we are giving 500 BP to each person in the top 100 teams  on the Chicken Defender Leaderboard (you can set a score with multiple teams, max 3000 BP per person). Leaderboard will reset on  December 21st. 

 DUO ROTATION 
With Defender Mode coming in, we have  temporarily  rotated Duo Grand Prix mode out. We would like to work with our community to try and create more rotating game modes. 

 CASUAL GP MODE RETURNS 
As the new players arrive, we have re-introduced Grand Prix and Grand Prix PRO (instead of PRO replacing the casual Grand Prix). Grand Prix PRO is once again unlocked at  level 30. 

 DIFFICULTY CHANGES 
We heard you out. Some cups are too difficult for players and have a very steep learning curve. RR cups  1-14  have had difficulty tweaks but we have kept cups  15 onwards  as is, as we feel the rewards are equal to the effort required to beat these cups. 

 WEEKLY PROGRESSION & SCRAP BOX ADDITION 
The weekly progression rewards have been adjusted. We have added a special Scrap Box instead of certain BP increments. 

 BATTLE PASS 
New Battle Pass is here! You can no longer purchase the Dino Pass, with that we introduce the new Pirate Pass - full of new goodies, a unique skin and Pirate loot boxes! As always, you  KEEP THE BATTLE PASSES  you have previously purchased. 

 GAMEPLAY CHANGES  
Dazes carrying through hoops stopped momentum and sometimes prevented players from engaging the hoop, thus falling down. This has been patched
Visual map fixes 
Descriptions and localisations

Hello everyone!

We’ve got another patch coming today! All the details are below, so let’s jump straight into it!

Topics for this update

 Proximity Chat
 New Engine Type: No Drift
 New Game Mode - Training Grounds
 Item Adjustments
 Hero Balance Changes
 Map Rotations & Changes
 Weekly Leaderboards and Reworks

PROXIMITY CHAT
Let us start off with the big new feature coming to Oh Baby Kart – proximity chat! Now, you can communicate with other racers in real-time when you’re close to them on the track. Whether it’s strategizing with allies, throwing playful taunts at your rivals, or sharing a quick laugh during intense races, proximity chat adds a new level of excitement and interaction.

NEW ENGINE TYPE 
In addition to Automatic and Manual modes, we are adding a new setting called “No Drift”. This new setting is aimed at brand new players to help them ease into the game and learn about the mechanics.

NEW GAME MODE - TRAINING GROUNDS
Introducing a new training mode where you can further develop your karting skills and accuracy. This new mode is aimed at experienced players to practise harder mechanics. 

NEW MAP

ITEM ADJUSTMENTS

 Beachball

notes.title: Upcoming OBK Patch 1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[previewyoutube=ssidB6DsMBE;full][ LINK ] [/previewyoutube]

We got a big patch coming on October 8, 2024, with significant changes. We’ve got all the details below, so let’s jump straight into it!

Topics for this update

 Free-to-Play
 Rewards
 New Maps
 New Game Mode - The Axel Tower
 New Items
 New Heroes and Tweaks
 Minor Gameplay Changes
 Difficulty Balancing for RR Cups and Challenges
 Localization

FREE-TO-PLAY
Let us start off with the big announcement. Oh Baby Kart (OBK) will be going free to play on October 8, 2024. What does that mean exactly? 

New Players. Starting on October 8, OBK will be available to download for free and all players will have access to most game modes and features, with some exceptions. Free-to-play players will have access to all online multiplayer game modes, but will NOT have access to a majority of current and future solo game modes (such as RR Cups and Challenges). This means that in order to unlock certain heroes that are tied to Challenges and RR Cups, you will need access to the full version. To unlock the full version - you just need to purchase anything from the shop (yes, that’s right, any purchase whether it be a battle pass or a collaboration item will give you the full version!). 

Existing Players. For players who currently own the game, that means you won’t have to do anything. The full version of the game is already unlocked for anyone who purchased the game. This means that those players can unlock all the heroes in the game, as well as any future challenges and RR Cups.

If you have more questions, check out our F.A.Q section below or reach out to us on Discord.

REWARDS
If you already own OBK, we want to say thank you! When OBK transitions into free-to-play, we will set up the following rewards for existing players:

 2x Preseason Boxes (now known as Base Boxes)
 Exclusive Bulma Maid Skin
 Exclusive Chibben Fast Food Skin
 The Dino Pass - this pass never expires
 Access to all existing and future game modes and challenges

The Bulma Maid and Chibben Fast Food skins will be exclusive one off gifts and will never come back. This is to say thank you for your support and for being such an incredible community! 

We also have additional rewards for players who went above and beyond:


 Players who are level 69+ will receive the School Huntress Skin
 Players who are level 100+ will receive a Tire Box (Epic Lootbox)
 First 100 players who reached Level 100 have received the Floral Border, a border that was only given to 100 people and will never come back
 
Note - additional rewards may be given and distributed on top of everything above in the form of additional lootboxes/BP. 

Again, we want to thank every single one of you for your amazing support! We hope that you will enjoy these special rewards!

NEW MAPS
The upcoming patch will also introduce 6 new maps. Additionally, 4 of these new maps will be special sprint maps. A sprint map is a one way map with checkpoints along the way. Instead of a repeating loop, a sprint map really rewards those who know the full map and the position of what is to come. 

NEW GAME MODE - THE AXEL TOWER
Big shoutout to Axelmeow and the art team! Introducing the Axel Tower, a new crazy mode where players will need to reach the top as fast as possible! This new game mode will also have a special event with rewards. Without spoiling too much, all we can say is….good luck!

NEW ITEMS
In addition to balancing existing items, we will be introducing new items to the pool. Depending on the map, you could turn into a rubber ducky, or make someone else turn into a turtle. 

NEW HEROES AND TWEAKS
There will be new heroes coming with this patch. We won’t be spoiling too much so we’ll only reveal 2 heroes now.

Elbow, the Dragon Duck
Elbow has a special ultimate that allows him to get full speed boost and steer if the first boost hits someone nearby. It’s a very risky ultimate because not only will you need to land it on to another driver, you have to also be able to control the new bonus steer on the hit. High Risk, High reward.|

Pas, some Random Game Designer
Pas' mechanics revolve around coins. He has the strongest boost in the game, but not only does his boost require triple the most expensive ultimate in the game, it will also remove all his coins upon usage. Additionally, he needs 25 coins to actually get the coin boost. 

A number of heroes will also get their stats tweaked.

MINOR GAMEPLAY CHANGES
After extensive testing, we realised that the difference between automatic and manual drifting was too wide. As such, we have improved the balancing of both and also increased the overall pace of the game. You want speed? We will give it to you!

DIFFICULTY BALANCING
We heard you out and changes in the difficulty curve of the RR Cups and Challenges have been made to allow for a more pleasant experience. 

LOCALIZATION
With this patch, we will be supporting more languages. These include:
 

 French
 Korean
 Japanese
 Simplified Chinese
 Traditional Chinese
 Dutch
 Vietnamese
 Spanish
 German

A big shout out to our community members who have been helping us translate the game! 

We’ve got a few other changes but we’ll leave them shrouded in mystery for you guys to find out! That is all we have for you for now. We hope that you will enjoy this amazing new patch!

FREE TO PLAY - F.A.Q

I bought Oh Baby Kart, what do I do?

Nothing! You already have access to the full game. In fact, if you owned the game before October 8, 2024, then you have access to additional rewards (see “Rewards” section).

I don’t have Oh Baby Kart but I want to play it. What should I do?

You can either buy the game on Steam before October 8, 2024 and receive some of the additional rewards mentioned above. Alternatively, you can wait until October 8, 2024 and play the online multiplayer game modes for free. Note that if you wait until October 8, 2024 and play the free-to-play version of the game, you will not have access to all solo game modes (some of which help you unlock heroes upon completion).

I want access to all game modes and features. What should I do?

If you already own the game prior to October 8, 2024, then you won’t have to do anything. You already have access to everything. For new players who download the free-to-play version of the game, in order to unlock all features, you just need to purchase anything from the store, whether it be a collaboration package or a pass. 

Does this mean all heroes are unlockable for all players?

All heroes will be unlockable to existing players or players that purchase the full version of the game. For free-to-play players, not all heroes will be unlockable. 

What about skins for heroes, will those be free too?

No, hero skins in the shop will still need to be bought. Nothing changed there.

notes.title: OBK Patch 0.620891
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

I will be doing a dev log video next week on what we are working on - worth looking out for!

1) Collisions and Bouncing off each other
I have done an adjustment to physics and collisions, more with walls and other karts. The reason for this change was it was still too bouncy which could be costly to the game. For those in Alpha there was a time when karts used to stick together, then we moved to extreme bounce - although this still needs more fine tuning, it should be closer to a much better feeling with less crazy bounces on maps such as Sky Dragons.

2) Item Changes
Item Longevity:
Some items have been changed to not last so long. For example, a beachball could persist for more than 10 seconds, which sort of breaks 'intention'. The intention of a player firing the beachball is to hit immediately or at most have a few seconds to bounce off a wall, and so gameplay should reflect that. The ball should not persist so long that a player in 1st can somehow hit a player in 10th, after 6 seconds. This is tuned to most items in the game.

OhBoBomb:
I have actually removed this item in 98% of cases, if not 100%. The reason for this came from community discussions. A player who is hit at first is likely going to be sent back to the shadowrealm not because of the OhBoBomb directly, but the players before them. The coin loss further adds to the loss. The solution was to remove it but more importantly allow Bonks to be accessible to other positions besides people so far at the back or tail end of the race. We still iterate but I believe this is a step in the right direction. Bonks still have global cooldowns to prevent max spamming (remember Beta 1?)

3) Map Fixes
More colliders fixed, poor out-of-bound magnet zones and hoops to improve flow of maps. 

4) Localisation
We are now looking for people who would like to help with localization. We have now started to set up all the items and are aiming for full multiple language support. 

5) Hero Changes
Huntress
Huntress rocket is 10% more ultimate cost

Jez
Freezing Boost timer of coin vaccum reduced from 3 to 1.5 seconds

Suit Shiba 
Ultimate costs reduced by 3%

Ohbibi
Drift Boost power 5% buff

Cobie
Ultimates have 5% reduced cost

Filian
Drift boost power increased 2%

Capy
Drift boost power increased 3%

Squidward
Drift boost power increased 0.5% (he is very sensitive to these adjustments)

SpongeBob/Otto
Drift Boost power increased by 5%

Peanut
Passive switched to Beachballs give speed

Chibben
Drift boost power increased 3%

Hope you enjoy this patch, look forward to seeing you on the track!

Physics Improvements:

notes.title: Major Patch v0.19230
notes.notes:
Major Patch v0.19230

Hello everyone, our notes for patch v0.19230!

Video:
[previewyoutube=z_xNkQXdyTA;full][/previewyoutube]
New UI Flow
We heard you, and we want to refine our UI/UX flows. The new set up may need some time getting used to but we wanted to reduce the amount of clutter in each play mode. This also allowed us to introduce new offline modes as well!

Offline Split Screen / Local player
A feature that was requested was being able to play offline and giving local split screen options. We added that functionality, so now you can play with your friends, partners or even practice offline whenever you feel like it!

Race Royale Cups
A new mode is added where you can truly test yourself in unique Race Royale Cups. These will start easy but get harder over time. Be warned, the last cups are very difficult, but each cup offers very special rewards for those who complete it. For those who want even more challenge, try setting the best time as well!

Race Royale Changes
The Race Royale mode was simply too unforgiving for new players (plus veterans were entering the normal Race Royales to complete quests), ultimately making a not so pleasant experience for new racers. This needed to be changed, so we made Race Royale a level 20+ only mode (Race Royale Pro) but to balance out daily quests that require specific characters - you no longer need to win, but just get to the last round of the Race Royale. 

We have also removed specific maps from the Race Royale PRO and GP PRO modes. Maps in the PRO modes should be a form of skill expression and not be heavily reliant on RNG/Luck. Examples of these maps including Parking Lot and Stadium. 

Map Changes
Many maps were frustrating to navigate for newer players, so ramps were added to prevent players going backwards. This also improved skill expression and flow of these maps. These maps included Mars, Test of Ice, Test of Strength and Vault.

Another common request was reducing the brightness/lens flare of certain maps. We felt the game was simply too bright, so there have been adjustments on every map to be less glaring but also fit the overall tone of the map's theme. 

Water Park has also been set to 2 laps now. 

Item Changes
Bonk + OhBobomb - Watching streamers and players get annoyed at these items meant we needed to do a much more influential change. Both items are now on a cooldown depending on player distribution in the race, as well as the time of use, meaning the time it is possible to get the item after use is very large and on smaller maps basically at 0. Furthermore, the OhBobomb in Race Royales are distributed differently, making it impossible for the last round players to pick up an additional OhBobomb. 

Rocket Daze has also been slightly decreased.

Hero Tweaks
Cobie: New Team Ultimate - Golden Bull Item Drop. Giving all team members a golden bull!
Capy: New Team Ultimate - Team Capytan. Booster pads improved for all team members
Degen/Krabs/Huntress: Slight improvement in steer and top speed in max coins
Peanut/Chibben: Ultimate cost has slightly increased
Squidward/Flamingo: Drift speed slightly improved
Dib/Stardust: Improved slipstream

Game Score Update
There are likely more changes that will happen for Game Score (especially those who are in far more competitive group leaderboards). For now, we have added a few more boxes to the current Games Scores. We have not changed BP distribution here.  

General Bug Fixes
- Colliders in general are fixed 
- Rocket explosion/collisions improved
- Respawns of many maps were fixed
- RNG on maps in custom games fixed
- Drift Sounds breaking fixed
- Challenge maps are now compiled into 3, instead of 6 (they haven't vanished, they are just all in the old maps to prevent clutter)
- Fixed some recipes not showing
- Fixed some items not showing craftable/sellable
- Removed R3 shortcut on controllers to prevent camera switching randomly
- Fixed visuals for some karts not showing and other items with wrong icons

notes.title: Developer Update #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Shogun Season running smoothly and we are loving your feedback. We heard you out and wanted to update you on what we are working on next. 

[previewyoutube=DuIWsWN69Po;full][/previewyoutube]

New Menu / UI Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765784/ce81c990d3462a4f4691e6ef904be5d5e7e8402e.png

We want to do a more organized approach to UI. We felt there was too much on the home page when you first opened the game. This was very overwhelming to a lot of our new players. We are changing the flow and separating modes out. 

Local Split Screen / Offline Play

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765784/b628123490b93c82d700aee744543875b53169c2.png

A mode that was heavily requested was split screen for couch/local play. We are enabling this mode with a clearer flow for you to play with friends and family locally. All the items you unlock are there for you and your friends to enjoy. 

We are also providing certain modes offline, allowing you to enjoy OBK wherever you are! 

Race Royale Cups

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765784/3953865886f22514a53fc22e2c6b527e7fcd5d43.png

Race Royale cups are a unique mode to OBK. These will start off easy and get much... much harder, they are a new take on the typical Grand Prix. There will be unique rewards from the Race Royale Cups.  Can you survive 4 Race Royales in a row?

Post Patch Metrics

We also wanted to take the time to update the meta changes post patch. Although the Shogun Season patch was last week, we wanted to give insight to the changes to the current meta as well as a little update to the game economy.

Leave a comment if you have any questions or any suggestions or join our Discord to stay up to date!
